rawQuery: I need 5 laptops for a small shop under 3 lakh INR total, each with at least 16 GB RAM, delivery within 10 days and a minimum one-year warranty.

catalog.disclaimer: Every record in this catalog is synthetic demo data. Brands and products are fictional. Prices, stock, delivery times, warranties and quality/reliability scores are illustrative only and were not retrieved from any retailer. No record has a source URL or a live check timestamp.

scoring.unitComposite: weights.quality * qualityScore + weights.reliability * reliabilityScore + weights.delivery * deliveryScore
scoring.deliveryScore: (maxDeliveryDays + 1 - deliveryDays) / (maxDeliveryDays + 1); only for products within the delivery limit
scoring.basketComposite: mean over required categories of the quantity-weighted mean unit composite
scoring.priceRole: hard budget limit and first tie-breaker; not part of the composite score

CHEAPEST.objectiveSummary: Lowest total cost among complete baskets that meet every hard constraint and the budget; higher composite score breaks ties.
warnings: Every item in this plan is synthetic demo data — confirm real prices, stock and delivery before paying.
